predictions: Sentences with ecosistema/écosystème/Ökosystem reach 0.8-1.2; ecology words and sentences without the eco-system word stay under 0.15. English 'file system'/'immune system' sit around 0.3 but are not tested.
notes: Card: 'cos' x3 (ecosistema, écosystèmes), plus other pieces before 'system' (파일, 文件, organ-ismo, Ö-kos); the opposite pole suppresses ' system'. Probe: ecosistema 1.152, écosystèmes 0.966; file system 0.316 vs file cabinet 0.127; 'immune' 0.325 in both 'immune system' and 'immune response'; 'el equilibrio del bosque' 0.068; 'organism' 0.004.
